title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP04d — P2 workflow switch to the trusted base runner
goal: Take every required check verdict from Invoke-IFXTrustedBase.ps1 in a base worktree outside the checkout, run trusted component candidate verification on pull requests when the base commit activates it, and declare trusted execution and candidate verification active in ci/jobs.json so that the activation contract applies from the next pull request, without renaming checks or changing the job graph.
acceptanceCriteria: Every job creates $RUNNER_TEMP/guard-base at the pull request base SHA or the current commit and takes its verdict from the base runner with -GateId equal to its check name; no job runs the head dispatcher in place.
v3-cross-platform-ubuntu-latest runs Test-IFXTrustedBaseCandidate on pull requests only when the base commit's ci/jobs.json declares tcbCandidateVerification active.

ci/jobs.json declares trustedBase execution and tcbCandidateVerification active, Invoke-IFXCiContract passes against the switched workflow, and Test-IFXCiContract rejects wrong single and matrix gate IDs, an in-place head dispatcher and a missing base worktree.
The 13 required check names, triggers and job dependencies are unchanged, and the runner reproduces this pull request's CI verdicts locally from a worktree of the CP04c base.
Plan 06 P2.1 is ticked with evidence and P2.8 is left for verification on the next pull request per D19.
